en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs. The upper image shows a straight, narrow street lined with colonial-style buildings, some with arcades and simple facades, receding into the distance. The lower image shows a broad, tree-lined avenue or path, with large trees forming a canopy over a dirt or gravel road. At the top margin of the postcard is printed the credit line: "J. P. Fernandes, Photographer, Lourenço Marques."
